<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                app:tint="@color/primary_blue"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="8dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="24dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="4dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="8dp">

        <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
        <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
            android:id="@+id/drawingView"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent" />

        <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
        <include
            android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
            layout="@layout/color_palette"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="bottom"
            android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginStart="16dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
            android:text="↶"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Clear Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnClear"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="68dp"
            android:layout_weight="1.5"
            android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
            android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
            android:text="@string/clear"
            android:textSize="20sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_orange"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_clear"
            app:iconGravity="textStart"
            app:iconTint="@color/white"
            app:iconSize="24dp"
            app:cornerRadius="34dp"
            app:elevation="12dp"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Redo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
            android:text="↷"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="8dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="24dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="4dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="8dp">

        <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
        <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
            android:id="@+id/drawingView"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent" />

        <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
        <include
            android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
            layout="@layout/color_palette"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="bottom"
            android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginStart="16dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
            android:text="↶"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Clear Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnClear"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="68dp"
            android:layout_weight="1.5"
            android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
            android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
            android:text="@string/clear"
            android:textSize="20sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_orange"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_clear"
            app:iconGravity="textStart"
            app:iconSize="32dp"
            app:cornerRadius="34dp"
            app:elevation="12dp"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Redo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
            android:text="↷"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

I have successfully upgraded the design of the icons for "Effacer", "Back", and "Next", and integrated them into the app with playful animations.

### 🌟 Design Upgrades:

1.  **Kid-Friendly Eraser Icon**:
    -   Redesigned `ic_clear.xml` as a colorful 2D eraser (pink with a blue sleeve).
    -   Updated the "Effacer" button in `activity_drawing.xml` with a larger `32dp` icon and set `app:iconTint="@null"` to display its full colors.
2.  **Playful Navigation Arrows**:
    -   Updated `ic_back.xml` and `ic_arrow_forward.xml` with thick, rounded arrows featuring white highlights for a "bubbly" look.
    -   Removed all hardcoded tints in layouts to ensure the new designs are visible.
3.  **Bouncy Button Animations**:
    -   Added a custom `animateBounce` extension function in `DrawingActivity.kt`.
    -   Applied this animation to the **Back**, **Clear**, and **Next** buttons to provide satisfying visual feedback for kids.

The buttons now look like toys and respond with a fun "pop" animation when tapped, making the app much more engaging for children.

            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="8dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="24dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="4dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="8dp">

        <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
        <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
            android:id="@+id/drawingView"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent" />

        <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
        <include
            android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
            layout="@layout/color_palette"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="bottom"
            android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginStart="16dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
            android:text="↶"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Clear Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnClear"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="68dp"
            android:layout_weight="1.5"
            android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
            android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/accent_orange"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_clear"
            app:iconGravity="top"
            app:iconTint="@null"
            app:iconSize="42dp"
            app:cornerRadius="34dp"
            app:elevation="12dp"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

        <!-- Redo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
            android:text="↷"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textColor="@color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_blue"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white" />

    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"

                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"

                android:scaleType="center" />

            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"

            app:strokeColor="@color/white"

            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"

        android:layout_height="0dp"

        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"

        android:gravity="center"

            android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/white"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_undo"
            app:iconGravity="top"
            app:iconTint="@null"
            app:iconSize="36dp"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple" />

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnClear"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="68dp"
            android:layout_weight="1.5"
            android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
            android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/white"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_clear"
            app:iconGravity="top"
            app:iconTint="@null"
            app:iconSize="46dp"
            app:cornerRadius="34dp"
            app:elevation="12dp"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange" />

        <!-- Redo Button -->
        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="60dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
            android:backgroundTint="@color/white"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_redo"
            app:iconGravity="top"
            app:iconTint="@null"
            app:iconSize="36dp"
            app:cornerRadius="30dp"
            app:elevation="8dp"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple" />

    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

**Implementing the Design**

I'm currently implementing the design changes for `activity_drawing.xml`. I've just added `ivCloudDrawingLeft` and `ivStarDrawingRight` as background decorations. Also, I'm working to replace `btnUndo` and `btnRedo` with `MaterialCardView` containers holding circular `ImageButton` elements to achieve the desired look.


**Adding Visual Elements**

I'm focused on populating the drawing activity layout. Right now, I'm integrating the visual enhancements. I'm adding `ivCloudDrawingLeft` and `ivStarDrawingRight`. Furthermore, I'll soon swap out the undo and redo buttons for `MaterialCardView` containers housing circular `ImageButton` elements to keep with the theme of circularity, and to maintain style consistency. My goal is to add a playful feel to the layout.

I'll now update `activity_drawing.xml` by adding decorative elements like clouds and stars, and redesigning the **Undo** and **Redo** buttons as circular, "bubbly" buttons for a more playful, kid-friendly look.

<!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="50dp"
                android:layout_height="50dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_butterfly"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

content.text:
I've upgraded the **Drawing Activity** design to be highly attractive and engaging for children:

### ✨ Visual Upgrades:
- **Floating Decorations**: Added semi-transparent **stars, clouds, and sparkles** to the background to create a magical atmosphere.
- **Mascot Presence**: Added a cute **butterfly mascot** 🦋 inside the drawing area to keep the child company while tracing.
- **Circular "Bubble" Buttons**: Redesigned **Undo**, **Redo**, and **Clear** as large, circular "bubbly" buttons with thick colorful borders and white backgrounds.
- **Bolder Drawing Area**: Increased the corner radius and stroke width of the main drawing card for a softer, more "toy-like" feel.

### 🎈 Interactive Improvements:
- **Impactful Animations**: All action buttons now use a **satisfying bounce animation** that scales the entire button card when tapped.
- **Improved Hierarchy**: The **Eraser (Clear)** button is now significantly larger and centered, making it the most prominent action for a child to find.

The activity now feels much more like a playful game while maintaining all original tracing logic.

        android:paddingBottom="28dp"

        android:paddingEnd="20dp"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🌈 Decorative Rainbow -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="60dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_rainbow"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnBackCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- 🐠 Moving Goldfish Lottie -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieGoldfish"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/goldfish"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"
                android:layout_width="60dp"
                android:layout_height="60dp"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- 🐯 Peaking Tiger Lottie -->
    <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
        android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
        android:layout_width="100dp"
        android:layout_height="100dp"
        android:layout_marginStart="-30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
        app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger"
        app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
        app:lottie_loop="true"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🌈 Decorative Rainbow -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="60dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_rainbow"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnBackCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- 🐠 Moving Goldfish Lottie -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieGoldfish"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/goldfish"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"
                android:layout_width="60dp"
                android:layout_height="60dp"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->
            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- 🐯 Peaking Tiger Lottie -->
    <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
        android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
        android:layout_width="100dp"
        android:layout_height="100dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="-30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
        app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger"
        app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
        app:lottie_loop="true"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
