<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🌈 Decorative Rainbow -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="60dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_rainbow"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnBackCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="12dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- 🐠 Moving Goldfish Lottie -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieGoldfish"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/goldfish"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"
                android:layout_width="60dp"
                android:layout_height="60dp"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- Peaking Tiger 🐯 (Mirrored with Butterfly) -->

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->

            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="-1dp"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger" />

            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="8dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_purple"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_rainbow">

    <!-- ✨ UPGRADED Fun Curved Toolbar -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/toolbar"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@drawable/bg_toolbar_fun"
        android:paddingTop="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="28dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <!-- ⬅️ Back Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnBack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_back"
                android:contentDescription="@string/back"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🌈 Decorative Rainbow -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="60dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_rainbow"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnBackCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="0dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- 🐠 Moving Goldfish Lottie -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieGoldfish"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="60dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/goldfish"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"
                android:layout_width="60dp"
                android:layout_height="60dp"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- Peaking Tiger 🐯 (Mirrored with Butterfly) -->

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->

            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="-1dp"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger" />

            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:elevation="12dp"

            android:id="@+id/btnBackCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"

            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"

            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"

            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"

                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"

                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->

            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="-1dp"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger" />

            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <ImageView

            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnBackCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- ☀️ Decorative Sun -->
        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="50dp"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_sun"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnMusicCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
            android:contentDescription="@null" />

        <!-- Hidden TextView for backward compatibility -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvLetterDisplay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- Hidden CardView for backward compatibility -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/letterDisplayCard"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />

        <!-- 🎵 Music Button with Circle Background -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnMusicCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_cyan"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRepeatCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnMusic"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/toggle_music"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- 🔊 Sound Button with Circle Background - BIGGER! -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRepeatCard"
            android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="28dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/accent_pink"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/white"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRepeat"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sound"
                android:contentDescription="@string/repeat_sound"
                app:tint="@color/white"
                android:scaleType="center" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    <!-- 🎨 FULL SIZE Drawing Area - MAXIMUM SPACE FOR TRACING! -->
    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:id="@+id/cardDrawing"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_margin="12dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
        app:cardElevation="0dp"
        app:strokeWidth="6dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/toolbar"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnActionLayout"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent">

            <!-- Drawing View - Full canvas -->
            <com.alphapals.app.utils.DrawingView
                android:id="@+id/drawingView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent" />

            <!-- Decorative Sparkle in Drawing Area -->
            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_sparkle"
                android:alpha="0.4"
                android:layout_margin="16dp"
                app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                android:contentDescription="@null" />

            <!-- Mascot Butterfly 🦋 -->
            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieButterfly"
                android:layout_width="60dp"
                android:layout_height="60dp"
                android:layout_margin="12dp"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/butterfly_lottie_animation"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

            <!-- Peaking Tiger 🐯 (Mirrored with Butterfly) -->

            <!-- 🎨 Color Palette - Inside the drawing card at the bottom -->

            <com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView
                android:id="@+id/lottieTiger"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="-1dp"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/colorPaletteLayout"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
                app:lottie_loop="true"
                app:lottie_rawRes="@raw/cute_tiger" />

            <include
                android:id="@+id/colorPaletteLayout"
                layout="@layout/color_palette"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <!-- Floating Background Decorations -->
    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="60dp"
        android:layout_height="40dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_cloud"
        android:alpha="0.3"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginStart="20dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="100dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <ImageView
        android:layout_width="30dp"
        android:layout_height="30dp"
        android:src="@drawable/ic_star"
        android:alpha="0.4"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        android:layout_marginEnd="30dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="120dp"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <!-- Action Buttons Layout (Undo, Redo, Clear) -->
    <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
        android:id="@+id/btnActionLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

        <!-- Undo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnUndoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnUndo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_undo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Undo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Clear Button (Big Eraser) -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnClearCard"
            android:layout_width="86dp"
            android:layout_height="86dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="43dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="4dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/accent_orange"
            app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/btnUndoCard"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnRedoCard"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnClear"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_clear"
                android:scaleType="centerInside"
                android:padding="12dp"
                android:contentDescription="@string/clear" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Redo Button Circle -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:id="@+id/btnRedoCard"
            android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="32dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/white"
            app:strokeWidth="3dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/primary_blue"
            app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
            app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRedo"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_redo"
                android:scaleType="center"
                android:contentDescription="Redo" />

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
